task_instance: Interpret a low PluginEval quick-depth score report: given a sample quick-depth JSON report for a skill (composite 61.5, Bronze, with a MISSING_TRIGGER flag and a weak triggering_accuracy dimension), apply the evaluation-methodology skill to explain how the composite is derived, verify the number against the documented formulas, identify the dimension holding the score down, and recommend concrete fixes with the expected score impact and the gap to the next badges.
evidence: This is a reference/methodology skill whose stated core use is understanding how quality is measured, interpreting a low score on a dimension, deciding how to improve, setting thresholds, and explaining badges. That deliverable is text analysis and needs no code execution, so it is fully achievable in this runtime. Read SKILL.md and references/improving-scores.md (both present in the skill folder). Created sample_report.json as the input a user supplies. Produced interpretation.md as the deliverable. Verified by hand against the methodology's own formulas: at quick depth only the static layer runs, so each measured dimension's value equals its static sub-score; weighted sum over the six measured dimensions = 0.1375+0.14+0.06+0.048+0.027+0.015 = 0.4275; measured dimension weights sum to 0.66, so renormalized 0.4275/0.66 = 0.647727 -> x100 = 64.7727; one anti-pattern gives penalty max(0.5, 1-0.05*1)=0.95; 64.7727 x 0.95 = 61.53, which matches the report's composite 61.5 and the Bronze band (>=60, <70) and the Estimated confidence label for quick depth. The interpretation also projects fixes (clearing MISSING_TRIGGER -> penalty 1.0 ~64.8; lifting frontmatter_quality 0.55->0.90 -> ~78.0 Silver; plus orchestration_wiring 0.70->0.85 -> ~82.6 Gold) using the same documented weights. Files produced: sample_report.json, interpretation.md, result.json in the work directory. No bundled script, model, or CLI was needed for this interpretation task; nothing was stubbed or fabricated.
